messages:
tara: Quick repro: Webpack+Terser build of the JS SDK for edge -> runtime error in worker: 'Redwood is not a function'.
jon: steps?
tara: Minimal repro: 1) package.json has {"type":"module"}; 2) import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'; 3) bundle with webpack 5 targeting 'webworker' and TerserPlugin enabled; 4) deploy to Cloudflare Worker. At runtime calling Redwood(...) throws.
indra: interesting. Could be tree-shaking + minifier mangling the re-export wrapper so default becomes a namespace. What does your ESM entry file look like?
tara: dist/index.mjs currently: `export * from './lib/core.js'; export { default } from './lib/core.js';`
sam: yep, that pattern can confuse bundlers + tersers. In our repro switching to an explicit import + re-export fixed it: `import core from './lib/core.js'; export default core; export * from './lib/core.js';`
jon: also check package.json fields: add "module" and "browser" keys pointing at the ESM entry. Some bundlers prefer module/browser for browser/edge targets over the exports map and that changes resolution.
tara: opened examples/webpack-edge-min-repro and a draft PR (#821) with the explicit wrapper and module/browser fields. CI currently failing because index.d.ts doesn't re-export lib types so TS users see missing methods.
ci-bot: nightly-smoke:edge-bundler-compat failed for examples/webpack-edge-min-repro (see CI logs).
indra: short-term workarounds for consumers: import the impl directly (`import { default as Redwood } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/lib/core.js'`) or pin webpack/terser options to avoid mangling re-export wrappers.
jon: action items: eng/devex land explicit ESM wrapper; eng/build add CJS interop glue and emit index.d.ts that re-exports lib types; eng/platform add CI job that builds with webpack+terser and runs a worker-shim; docs: add an "Edge bundler gotchas" note.
tara: will update the PR with types + CI adjustments. If anyone hits this, paste webpack version + terser/version + build flags + target runtime and we'll add it to the triage matrix. Thanks!
